neutral-1.$description: Warm neutrals (hue ~85 paper by day, ~70 roost at night). Chroma stays low so chrome reads neutral; colour is reserved for action, status and identity.

coral-3.$description: Caw coral: brand and the action. #E65D46 at rest.

spark.$description: Spark yellow, paper and roost ink: brand moments only (wordmark, mascot, art).

error-3.$description: Functional hues (Flexoki-derived). Error sits on crimson (hue 15) so failed never reads as the coral action.

mark-1.$description: Identity marks: eight hues at one lightness (projects, sessions).

account-amber.$description: Account colours (core AccountHue): an account's identity, drawn on the identity-mark hues, which hold contrast on paper and at night.

account-reserved.$description: The part of an account's week rim that sits under its reserve, once the reserve is reached: a mid neutral that reads on paper and at night.

mark-overlay.$value: linear-gradient(oklch(from {color.neutral-1} l c h / 0.22), oklch(from {color.neutral-12} l c h / 0.06))

mark-deck-shade.$description: Laid over a session mark's deck cards, a step stronger per card (SessionMark): the delegates behind the tile, darker with depth.

mark-deck-cast.$description: The shadow the card in front casts on the band of the next deck card that shows.

hue-cyan-400.$description: Identity hues for duotone icon tiles (new-session modal, Configure). Dark keeps each hue's chroma and raises its lightness.

tool-run.$description: Tool ink: one hue per tool family, one lightness per scheme.

card.$description: shadcn bridge: the kit's own names, resolved to the ramps.

accent.$description: The subtle hover surface, never brand.

surface-page.$description: Surfaces: the frame recesses, content sits raised on it.

surface-band.$description: A table's header band, one step under the field.

surface-well.$description: A content well inside a raised card (the plan's and the preview's beside a conversation): the recess by day; at night the deep recess, which the raised card's own lightness would otherwise all but meet.

surface-shelf.$description: The bar folder tabs stand on, a step below recess-deep.

tab-recede-1.$description: An unchosen folder tab on the phone's row, one tab from the chosen one. Each tab further recedes a step toward the shelf, to three.

tab-recede-2.$description: An unchosen folder tab on the phone's row, two tabs from the chosen one.

tab-recede-3.$description: An unchosen folder tab on the phone's row, three or more tabs from the chosen one.

surface-tile.$description: An icon tile's ground (DESIGN.md: the duotone glyph on a raised 26px tile): the raised surface by day; at night two steps past it, raised meeting the recess it stands on.

surface-fill-strong.$description: A filled control a step over surface-fill: its hover, and its on state (a parent's child count when its children are open).

surface-hover.$description: Hover on any control or row, the hover ghost under a list's row (highlight), and what rises over a hovered row. By day two steps past the field, so it shows on the field, the recess and a raised surface alike.

well-edge.$description: The reader's well edge: darker than the well by day, the ink at 8% at night.

seam.$description: Every divider: the transcript's user-message seam, section rules, the seams between machines and lists. The coral ramp at a subtle strength.

surface-1.$description: Surface ladder: eight levels that nest; each container lifts one step off what it sits on. Light flattens to warm white after step 2 (shadow carries depth); dark lightens ~3.2% L per step.

border.$description: Borders: graded, never flattened to one value.

border-well.$description: The edge of a well (surface-well): the hairline by day; at night the control edge, the hairline being all but invisible on the deep recess.

border-contrast.$description: The top bar's glass, solid under Increase Contrast or Reduce Transparency: its edge holds 3:1 against the bar and against the raised surface it encloses (5.4 and 4.0 by day, 3.8 and 4.7 at night).

border-card.$description: An icon card's edge (New project's templates, the empty fleet's ways in) on the recess: the control edge by day; at night a step past it, the control edge all but meeting the recess.

border-button-outline.$description: The outline button's edge, 3:1 against the raised surface it stands on, where the control edge measures 1.37:1 by day and 1.43:1 at night (the owner's pick, 'Strengthen to 3:1', WCAG 1.4.11): #958E84 on #FEFDFA, 3.19:1, by day; #766F66 on #23211E, 3.26:1, at night.

ink-strong.$description: Inks. Subtle is the weakest mix that holds 4.5:1 on fill, hover and raised.

ink-row.$description: A ledger row's name, just under the strongest ink.

ink-stat.$description: A stat tile's figure, a step lighter than the strongest ink.

ink-subtle.$description: Placeholders and tertiary text: the weakest mix of neutral-8 into neutral-11 that holds 4.5:1 on fill, hover and raised (by day 4.55 / 4.55 / 5.66:1 at 6%, hover being the fill's own step; the cool ramp's 8.3% measured 4.47 on the warm fill).

brand-solid.$description: Brand: coral for marks, badges and brand moments.

brand-ink-strong.$description: Brand ink under the pointer: the most saturated vermillion a word can take and still hold 4.5:1 on the pane (4.78:1 by day, 7.65:1 at night). brand-hover measures 3.9:1 by day and is for fills.

action-solid.$description: The action: coral under a white label. Darkened from the direction's 58.5/63% so white holds 4.5:1 on every stop of the gradient.

action-surface.$value: linear-gradient(oklch(from {color.action-solid} calc(l + 0.03) c h), oklch(from {color.action-solid} calc(l - 0.03) c h))
action-surface.$description: The action is never flat: a top-highlight gradient, lifted ±0.03 L so the top stop keeps 4.5:1 under white.

action-surface-hover.$value: linear-gradient(oklch(from {color.action-hover} calc(l + 0.03) c h), oklch(from {color.action-hover} calc(l - 0.03) c h))

selected-bg.$description: Selected nav / chosen row: warm apricot wash, coral ink, no shadow.

chip-chosen-bg.$description: Chosen option chip (1/2/3 keys in agent questions): solid vermillion, no ring. Dark sits at the dark action's lightness so the white digit holds 4.5:1 (the direction's 66% measured 3.33:1).

ink-solid.$description: Ink-solid: tooltips and inverted tiles stay ink, never coral.

focus-ring.$description: Focus: one 2px coral ring, keyboard focus only.

status-live-bg.$description: Status: four hues and a hueless idle (idle carries no fill). Needs-you is spark yellow, the one status that asks for a person.

status-live-glyph.$description: Status glyphs: the hue itself, not the near-black text ink, so a row's state reads in colour at a glance. Each holds 3:1 or more (non-text) on raised, page, fill, hover, the selected wash and the needs-you wash, in both themes; idle stays neutral.

nest-ink.$description: The nesting lines' ink (.kit-nest, WorkflowRail): one opaque neutral, about 2.3:1 to 2.5:1 against the sidebar and the phone home in both themes (a little past step 8 in light, between steps 7 and 8 in dark). A step lighter than the 3:1 it stood at, which read as heavy; never a faint hairline, and never an alpha, so two strokes that cross are the colour of one.

meter-calm.$description: Usage meters (design/usage-tracker.md §1, §8): coral is a window with room, spark yellow one near its limit (70% used, or a run-out under an hour away), crimson one from 90%. Each fill rides a lighter step of its own ramp; every fill/track pair passes the dataviz validator (--ordinal) on each surface it is drawn on, in both themes.

meter-share.$description: The one neutral the usage breakdown and history bars draw in.

meter-wash-near.$description: A near or over row's only tint: a faint wash of its status ink (owner: "the tints for yellow/red are too overwhelming").

count-wash-live.$description: The chosen work tab's count, washed in its status ink at the usage tints' strength.

scrollbar-thumb.$description: Every scrollbar's thumb, inherited from the root.

skeleton-sheen.$description: The band of raised surface that crosses a skeleton once per loop.

identity-ink.$description: Project identity ink at hue 0; the identity-ink utility turns it to the project's --identity-h. 48%, not 50%: on a row's hover surface the cyan end of the wheel fell to 4.39:1 at 50%, and 48% holds every one of the ten hues above 4.5:1.

machine-offline.$description: A machine that is not online: between the mid and muted neutrals.

data-ok.$description: Data colour: chroma survives in numerals.

note-new-ink.$description: Release-note section labels (ReleaseNotes): New green, Improved cyan, Fixed amber. Each ink sits on its own faint fill at 4.5:1 or more in both themes.

rail.$value: linear-gradient(oklch(from {color.neutral-11} l c h / 0.4), oklch(from {color.neutral-11} l c h / 0.4))
rail.$description: The transcript rail: one flat 2px line down a run of tool rows. An image, not a colour: rows paint it as a sized background layer (2px wide), and a colour would fill the whole row. Head and continuing rows paint the same, so no seam shows between them.

material-panel.$description: Chrome materials: structural translucency, never decoration.

scrim.$description: What a dialog's backdrop paints: the page itself, translucent.

image-outline.$description: The 1px edge drawn inside a raster image (the brand row's icon), so it keeps its shape on any surface. Pure black by day and pure white at night, never a tinted neutral: a tint picks up the surface under it and reads as dirt on the image's edge. An image whose own edge is darker than the surface it sits on (the paywall's night film band on the raised sheet) takes it one width outside instead: inside, 10% white over its near-black edge comes out the surface's own colour and parts nothing.

shadow-tint.$description: Elevation tints: warm ink by day, the deepest surface at night, never rgba black.

night-ring.$description: At night every raised shadow adds a 1px inner ring of ink.

shadow-tile.$value: 0 1px 2px light-dark(oklch(from {color.neutral-12} l c h / 0.07), oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.3)), 0 0 0 1px light-dark(oklch(from {color.neutral-12} l c h / 0.035), oklch(from {color.neutral-12} l c h / 0.06))

shadow-stat.$description: A stat tile's lift: drawn below the card, not around it; ringed at night.

shadow-overlay-hung.$description: A hanging surface whose top shows its own surface across the cut into its anchor (Caw's panel, kit-hang): the overlay's drop without the night ring, which would draw across the cut as a seam.

shadow-drop.$description: A drawn shape's drop (the grown composer), set as drop-shadow() filters so it follows the shape, not a box: this far layer, then shadow-drop-near.

surface-shadow-1.$description: Shadow per surface level, paired with --surface-1…8.

action-ring.$description: The action's edge: a white top hairline and a coral-tinted drop.

code-ring.$description: Inner vermillion ring and soft inner glow on code blocks.

font-wordmark.$description: Caw&Co wordmark: the approved landing's Nunito Variable face.

font-sans.$description: Figtree for UI and transcript prose, 400 and 500 only.

font-mono.$description: JetBrains Mono for code, paths, IDs and measurements; ligatures off.

weight-wordmark.$description: The landing wordmark's variable-font weight. Brand only.

track-wordmark.$description: The landing wordmark's tracking; the ampersand shares its face and size.

text-meta.$description: The six sizes text takes. Dense roles hold one size at every width; title and kpi scale with the viewport between 390 and 1024px.

text-code.$description: Code runs a step under body: JetBrains Mono sets large.

leading-root.$description: Tailwind preflight's root line height: what a row that sets no leading of its own inherits (the transcript's rail lines).

leading-prose-sm.$description: A rendered document's running text (@tailwindcss/typography prose-sm, the project page's docs card): 24/14.

prose-sm-title-before.$description: prose-sm: above an h2, in the heading's own ems.

prose-sm-title-after.$description: prose-sm: below an h1 or h2, in the heading's own ems.

prose-sm-h3-before.$description: prose-sm: above an h3, in the heading's own ems.

prose-sm-h3-after.$description: prose-sm: below an h3, in the heading's own ems.

prose-sm-h4-before.$description: prose-sm: above an h4 to h6, in the heading's own ems.

prose-sm-h4-after.$description: prose-sm: below an h4 to h6, in the heading's own ems.

prose-sm-quote.$description: prose-sm: above and below a blockquote, in the body's ems.

prose-sm-quote-inset.$description: prose-sm: a blockquote's text inset from its rule, in the body's ems.

prose-sm-rule.$description: prose-sm: above and below a horizontal rule, in the body's ems.

prose-sm-table-size.$description: prose-sm: a table's font size, in the body's ems. A hair over 12px of 14px, which is what makes a browser take the face's 3px descent up to 4.

weight-strong.$description: Nothing in product UI goes above 500.

type-meta.$description: Role shorthands (font: var(--type-label)). A kpi figure is always .num: the shorthand resets font-variant-numeric.

type-title.$description: Set with its tracking: the web's `text-title` utility carries it (app.css @theme, `--text-title--letter-spacing`), and the native role carries the same token.

space-1.$description: Measured off the comps, deliberately not a 4px ladder. Keep the odd values.

space-group.$description: Between the groups of a page (stat row, queue, a card).

space-row.$description: Between the rows of one list in the rail (the home's Working and Finished, a tree's children there): rows of one list, not separate things.

radius-hair.$description: Hair: chart swatches, a tooltip's arrow.

radius-sm.$description: Controls inside a surface, nav rows, menu items.

tab-icon-r.$description: The tab icon's tile, at the 16px a tab draws it; its bitmap scales the corner with its side.

caw-peek.$description: Caw's 512 box on the channel cards: he stands behind the chosen card and looks over its top edge.

caw-peek-rise.$description: How far that box rises above the cards (56.84% of caw-peek): clear room kept above them.

c-nav-h.$description: A nav row; touch screens and narrow windows take the 44px row.

c-rail-row-h.$description: A Configure rail row; touch screens and narrow windows take the 44px row.

c-toolbar-zone.$description: A ledger's toolbar zone, holding 32px controls 11px in.

c-top-bar-h.$description: The shell's top bar at every width: 43px and its 1px hairline, the compact bar's height (Apple HIG, Toolbars). Hosted tabs stand on its floor, a tab row's height below its top.

c-bar-toggle-glyph.$description: The phone bar's sidebar toggle: a bare glyph, its leading edge c-bar-phone-edge from the screen's and its centre on the tabs' centre line, in a 44px touch area.

c-bar-phone-edge.$description: The phone bar's two ends: the toggle glyph's leading edge and Caw's glass stand this far in from the screen's edges.

c-bar-phone-gap.$description: On the phone bar, the first tab starts this far after the toggle glyph, and the strip stops this far short of Caw's glass.

c-edge-pull.$description: On a phone, the strip along the screen's left edge where a finger that travels right pulls the sidebar out; a drag that starts further in is the page's (the chat swipe).

c-tab-lead.$description: A phone tab's pad before its title past the folder overlap, the tab's corner radius (the approved row's 12px): the row draws no status glyph, its rim is the status. Its title's trailing room is the folder overlap plus the chosen sheet's flare. Both ends keep the overlap on every tab, chosen or not, so a neighbour tucked over either end never touches the title and a choice never resizes a tab.

c-tab-row-h.$description: A session tab row: its list's 4px pad over 32px tabs (PaneTabs).

c-head-fade.$description: A transcript's head blur, on every width: rows scrolled up under the tab strip go out of focus over this length at the transcript's top edge (c-head-fade-blur at the edge, sharp at its end), so they never meet the tab's rim edge-on. It comes in over the first c-head-fade of scroll; scrolled to the very top there is none and the first row is sharp (HeadFade on the web and in CawCoKit).

c-head-fade-blur.$description: The head blur's radius at the transcript's top edge, its strongest layer. The layers under it halve (2, 1, 0.5px) toward the band's end, their slices bounded at inOutCubic positions (HeadFade on the web and in CawCoKit). A blur, never a colour. The recall wheel's far edge goes out of focus with the same layers, over a row and the room above it (grown.ts).

c-recall-cross-blur.$description: A pick taken off the recall wheel: the row on the line gives way to the field's own text in place, blurring out by this much as it fades, so the words it shares with the field read as one and only the rest dissolves (transitions.dev, text swap soft).

c-deck-peek.$description: While the recall wheel is up, the composer's buttons fold into a deck at the pill's trailing end, Send in front: how far each button peeks out past the one in front of it (Composer).

c-deck-scale.$description: A button in the recall wheel's deck, against the one in front of it: its size (Composer).

c-deck-dim.$description: A button in the recall wheel's deck, against the one in front of it: its opacity (Composer).

c-tab-max-w.$description: The widest a session tab grows: its title, padding and close control. Below it a tab is as wide as its title; only a title past it ends in an ellipsis, and a row of tabs that will not fit scrolls (PaneTabs).

c-bar-group-pad.$description: The top bar's icon group's inset round its items, and the bar's round its controls: the 44px bar less the 36px control height, halved. The group is a capsule and its items sit concentric inside it.

c-bar-item.$description: An item in the top bar's icon group: the group's height, the bar's control height, less its inset on both sides.

c-bar-symbol.$description: A symbol in the top bar's glass group: the machines glyph and Caw's head.

c-bar-caw-glass-phone.$description: Caw's own glass on the phone bar, its side: round at its leading side, square at its trailing one, flush with the screen's trailing edge. Caw's phone glass tops with the tabs and stands clear of the floor; open, his panel hangs from the floor through a neck (c-tab-row-h less this, his glass's foot to the row's floor).

c-bar-caw-head-phone.$description: Caw's head in his phone glass: the glass less the desktop item's 4px margin round its head on each side.

c-caw-ring.$description: The stroke of the arcs on Caw's rim in the top bar, one for each thing waiting on the operator.

c-page-head-h.$description: A page head under the top bar.

c-composer-field.$description: The group composer's field at one line; every transcript keeps the composer's standing parts clear at its foot.

c-ask-diff-share.$description: How tall a permission card's diff of the change it asks for stands before it scrolls, as a share of the screen's height: open, and two fifths of the screen at most, so Approve and Deny stay in reach.

c-composer-w.$description: The group composer's column: its panel, the cards parked over it and its tray, and whatever stands in its place (a thread's lead-off line).

c-suggest-chip.$description: A suggestion chip: its Tab key cap, padding and border.

c-tray-chip.$description: The delegate tray's row: a chip, and the step down to the pill.

row-mark.$description: The reader's row mark: 17×17 with an 11px glyph, centred in the 18px speaker cell.

tx-x-rail.$description: The transcript's rail edge from a row's inline start (app.css .tx-columns --x-rail); 0 at 900px wide and under (tx-x-rail-narrow).

tx-w-glyph.$description: The transcript's glyph cell (--w-glyph): the glyph column sits a space-3 past the rail, the text column a space-2 past the cell.

tail-row.$description: One row of a session's live tail (DelegateTail.svelte ROW): six stand in the tail, the top one dissolving under the mask.

hover-panel-max.$description: The widest the shared hover panel grows (HoverPanel.svelte .cell): its content is this less the 2px border and its space-3 padding.

hover-panel-inset.$description: The least room between the shared hover panel and the viewport's block edges when it stands beside a list (HoverPanel.svelte .panel.right).

tx-line.$description: A transcript rail line's least height: a tool call, a note, a branch head.

tx-compact-caw.$description: Caw's head before the word on a compaction's divider (CompactionDivider.svelte `.caw`).

tx-compacting-caw.$description: Caw at work before "Compacting…" while a compaction runs in its divider's place (CompactionDivider.svelte `.live .caw`); he settles to tx-compact-caw as it ends.

tx-compact-wave.$description: The box a compaction divider's wave is drawn in (CompactionDivider.svelte `.wave`): its line runs along the middle, 1.5px either side.

tx-code-margin.$description: A fenced block's margin in a message (my-3).

tx-diff-row.$description: A diff's row (@pierre/diffs), its bar between hunks, its box's cap.

tx-diff-head-block.$description: A diff's file header padding (py-2 px-3).

tx-field-cap.$description: A tool call's disclosed field, before it scrolls.

tx-shot.$description: An image card's box (Shot), and a thumbnail's.

prose-sm-block.$description: prose-sm: above and below a paragraph or a list (1.1428571em of 14px).

prose-sm-table.$description: prose-sm: above and below a table, inside its scrolling wrapper, so it never collapses into its neighbours' margins (2em of the table's 12px).

prose-sm-item-inset.$description: prose-sm: an item's own inset past its list's (0.4285714em of 14px).

prose-sm-nested-list.$description: prose-sm: above and below a list inside an item (0.5714286em of 14px).

list-marker-padding.$description: The browser's own gap between an outside disc marker and its item (WebKit RenderListMarker `markerPadding`): the disc's start stands this far, plus two thirds of the font's ascent and a pixel, out from where the item starts.

prose-code-pad.$description: Inline code's block padding where the shared prose classes set it (lib/prose.ts `[&_code]:py-0.5`): a document, a tool's markdown, a reasoning step.

tx-code-span-pad.$description: Inline code's block padding in a turn's words (MessageBody `code`).

tx-option.$description: A question card's option, at its least.

tx-beat.$description: A branch's live beat; the compacting and catch-up beat is tx-beat-lg.

tx-preview-max.$description: A preview tool's card: widest, least tall, its thumbnail.

status-dot-size.$description: A tree mark's status dot, centred on the tile's top-right corner (TreeMark).

status-dot-cut.$description: How much of the tile is cut away round its status dot, so the dot reads on any tile hue.

row-compact-h.$description: A compact session row's height: one line, in a tree in the rail (SessionRow).

row-compact-gap.$description: A compact session row's gap between its mark, its name and its age, and its leading inset: tight, where the name has the least room, and wide enough that the mark's status dot clears the name.

row-compact-pad-end.$description: A compact session row's trailing inset: where every row in the rail ends.

ghost-presence.$description: A message not yet said in the conversation (sending, queued).

surface-hover-mix.$description: Relative tints for rows inside any surface: hover +6%, selected +10% ink.

tab-rim-mix.$description: How much of its session's status colour an unchosen session tab's rim carries, on every width; its glow carries half of it.

tab-rim-mix-chosen.$description: The chosen session tab's rim, on every width.

tab-rim-mix-idle.$description: An idle session's rim, chosen or not, in the muted ink.

ease-out.$description: Entrances and exits ease out; on-screen movement eases in-out; drawers, popovers and page swaps use the drawer curve. No ease-in.

ease-arrive.$description: A small mark arriving beside what it belongs to (the compaction divider's chevron): it leaves at once and takes most of its time settling, so a 160ms entrance reads as motion where ease-out reads as a swap.

ease-figure.$description: A strategy figure's travel and growth (Configure → Accounts): a session riding into its lane, a bar filling, a lane reordering. The owner's reference motion, from the Projects mockups (mocks/project-paths).

ease-glide-in.$description: A glide's first stretch: speed rising evenly from rest (its position the square of its time), into the steady pace a tree's line, its room and the rows under it travel at.

ease-glide-out.$description: A glide's last stretch: from the steady pace, speed falling evenly to rest.

dur-stagger.$description: Between one row of an opening tree and the next: its line reaches each in turn at a steady pace, one row's room per stagger.

dur-cascade.$description: The most an opening tree's line takes to reach its last row: a longer tree's rows come closer together.

dur-ghost.$description: The hover ghost following the pointer from row to row.

dur-toggle.$description: A switch's knob and a checkbox's tick.

dur-morph.$description: A button's width following its label while it works.

dur-rail.$description: A transcript row's place opening, its rail drawing down with it.

dur-fade.$description: Fades that carry a state change in place.

dur-mark-hold.$description: The longest a transcript that opens on a compaction holds its reveal for Caw's mark to be drawn, so the first frame that shows the list shows him. A bound, not a pace: the list is shown the moment he is ready (about 90ms on a cold load), and at the bound without him. Under --dur-wait-grace, so the hold shows nothing of its own.

dur-wait-grace.$description: How long a wait runs before its loading state (Caw at loading or reconnecting) appears; a shorter wait shows its plain surface. NN/g, Response Times: no special feedback is needed for delays under 1.0 second.

dur-grow.$description: The composer growing up out of its history button: into the recall wheel, or by the one row that says a queued message is being edited.

dur-grow-exit.$description: The grown composer folding back into its history button, shorter than its growth.

dur-lift.$description: A queued message's words flying between its bubble and the composer field, either way, two copies crossfading on the drawer curve.

dur-press-hold.$description: How long a touch rests on the composer, keyboard down, before the recall wheel comes up under it.

dur-settle.$description: The existing motion/spring.ts response for non-paging surface settlement. Paging uses UIScrollView's system mechanics.

dur-reveal.$description: A disclosure growing open (collapsible-content); it folds shut over dur-exit.

dur-hold.$description: How long a done state stays up.

dur-loop.$description: One turn of an ambient loop: spinner, pulse, ping.

leave-scale.$description: How far Caw shrinks as he fades out, from any drawing, over dur-fade on ease-out, and the size a Caw whose status has no drawn enter fades in from, over dur-pop. Material 3, Easing and duration: exit transitions are faster than enters, 200ms.

deck-step.$description: How far each card of a session mark's deck shows below the one in front (SessionMark).

deck-shrink.$description: How much smaller each deck card is than the one in front: card i is the tile scaled by 1 - 0.11 x i.

deck-shade-step.$description: How much more of the deck's shade each card behind takes.

echo-scale.$description: How far a working session's echo grows from its tile before it has faded (motion/echo).

echo-opacity.$description: A working session's echo as it leaves the tile.

glyph-duo-status-opacity.$description: The duotone second layer of a status glyph in an alert row (join/JoinedRow): the lowest at which it holds 3:1 on the recess in both schemes for the ink-strong, done and attn glyph inks, the attn glyph by day being the floor. Every other Solar glyph keeps 0.5.

account-stale-opacity.$description: An account whose reading is out of date: its rings and its relay band draw at this opacity, the lowest at which every account hue holds 3:1 on the raised surface in both schemes (by day 0.7 is the floor for mark-2 to mark-7, at night 0.65).

ride-fade.$description: The first stretch of its nesting line over which a child's icon fades in as it leaves its parent's (motion/branch).
